feeds.title: Modern Mix Vancouver
feeds.description: Since 2008, Vanessa has kept her readers and followers 'in the know' on local happenings, facilitating for the discovery and support of brands, businesses, and experiences available in Vancouver. She combines her expertise in living a modern Vancouver lifestyle with an approachable relatability that inspires her followers to think. Visit her blog and learn more about events, lifestyle, fashion, retail, beauty, skincare, food, drink, health, wellness, and more.

feeds.title: Cosmetic Proof Blog » Nails
feeds.description: I am a 30-something young professional living in Vancouver, BC with my husband and two rescue cats, Hugo and Hemingway. I review various cosmetics I use or have used in this blog. With every review, I will attempt to use facts and observations to show you, the readers, that my conclusions for a product are true, sound or QED.

feeds.title: Natalie Langston Blog
feeds.description: Here you'll find a collection of my best tips and tricks for family, fashion, lifestyle, healthy living, home decor, and so much more. Natalie is a Vancouver-based TV Host, Lifestyle Expert & Fitness and Health Reporter. She helps busy moms create an attractive, easy, and affordable lifestyle while building a connected community of friends.

feeds.title: A Life Well Consumed
feeds.description: A Vancouver-based lifestyle blog created by Leslie Rossi. A Life Well Consumed is filled with informative and fun content covering a variety of topics such as travel, beauty, motherhood, food, and lifestyle. Leslie Rossi is a Vancouver-based blogger and YouTuber who specializes in everything beauty, travel and cocktails.

feeds.title: Hello Vancity » Lifestyle
feeds.description: Discover the latest Vancouver Lifestyle, Cool Tech & Travel Adventure trends. Hello Vancity magazine is an insider's view on the latest tech, fashion, travel, and lifestyle trends.

feeds.title: Good Life Vancouver » Life
feeds.description: We're here to help you suss out what's happening in food, culture, beer and wine in and around the great city of Vancouver. Bringing you the latest lifestyle and hospitality industry news and events with reviews and announcements. Good Life Vancouver is your guide to good life in Vancouver and often far beyond!

feeds.title: Mag Mei Adventures » Lifestyle
feeds.description: Mag Mei Adventures is like hanging out with a fun, fearless friend who's always discovering cool food spots, events, and life moments around Vancouver. Whether she's reviewing tacos or sharing what's happening in the city, her posts feel personal, honest, and just plain entertaining.

feeds.title: Vancouverscape
feeds.description: Well HELLO there! Glad you stopped by. Founded in 2010, Vancouverscape is an award-winning blog written and edited by designer, writer, and photographer Ariane Colenbrander. Our site's focus is on luxury travel, tech, and lifestyle.

feeds.title: WTF Bride Blog
feeds.description: WTF Bride is like chatting with a well-meaning, honest friend who's been through wedding chaos and is helping people navigate it.

feeds.title: Christy Blog
feeds.description: Christy Tales is a blog by Christy, a designer and businesswoman from Vancouver who also spends time in Seattle. She writes about travel, lifestyle, fashion, beauty, food, and business. Her posts include things like travel guides.

feeds.title: Gastrofork » Lifestyle
feeds.description: Gastrofork was created out of the love of food and travel that bonds her family and friends. From sharing her dining-out experiences, cooking and entertaining at home, or visiting her favorite places around the world - she wants to share her journey with people.

feeds.title: Girl Who Would be KING
feeds.description: Girl Who Would Be KING is an elegant lifestyle blog that blends mindfulness, style, wellness, and personal growth. It's about appreciating small rituals, celebrating everyday elegance, nurturing your habits, and finding inspiration.

feeds.title: Maddy Loves Blog
feeds.description: Maddy Loves is a Vancouver beauty, fashion, and lifestyle blog by Sheila, an ifestyle, and fashion blogger. Whether it is a product review, brand feature, tutorials, or styled looks, Maddy Loves will bring you everything related.

feeds.title: CityNews Vancouver » Lifestyle
feeds.description: Stories and info on trends in fashion, food, beauty and design as well as tips for travel, parenting, self care and more.

feeds.title: FOLIO.YVR
feeds.description: Vancouver's premiere eco-luxury magazine Folio.vr embraces and portrays the unique eco-luxury lifestyle of the city through a curated mix of editorials and in-depth features. Get exclusive and interesting content about Health & Wellness, Dining & Beverages, Fashion, Sustainable Shopping, and many more topics.

feeds.title: Vancouver Guardian » Lifestyle
feeds.description: The Vancouver Guardian's Lifestyle section t's all about the small, heartfelt stories that make the city feel real and personal. Whether it's giving a dog a second chance at a loving home or introducing you to a rising performer.

feeds.title: Samantha Sito
feeds.description: A Vancouver Based Blog covering Fashion, Lifestyle and Travel! Since it's inception back in 2011, this blog has grown into a hub for sharing what I love in the realm of Fashion, and meshing that with what we all go through, LIFE! I love to share my thoughts and my life with all of you, and I've been extremely fortunate to have this platform to do so. I've covered major events in Vancouver, Canada and internationally.

feeds.title: EcoLux Lifestyle
feeds.description: Explore content on Cruelty Free Beauty, Sustainable Fashion, Changemakers & Personalities, Travel, and More! EcoLuxLifestyle.co is Vancouver, BC's premiere lifestyle magazine for the eco-aware that embraces small Canadian eco-friendly businesses and the entrepreneurs who run them. Our lifestyle content is west coast oriented and aims to provide you with update-to-date info on healthy, conscious, and compassionate living.

feeds.title: Comfy Girl With Curls
feeds.description: Comfy Girl with Curls, led by Kaya Marriott, is a lifestyle blog centred on natural hair and personal reflections. Based in Vancouver, BC, Kaya, a Black Canadian blogger, offers support and inspiration, touching on beauty, entrepreneurship, and more. Her platform uplifts and empowers others on their journeys, fostering positivity and community.

feeds.title: Postcards From Hawaii
feeds.description: Welcome to Postcards from Hawaii, a travel & lifestyle blog for everyone who wants to do more on & for the planet. I'm Gabriella, an English-Mauritian blogger living in Vancouver, Canada. I launched Postcards from Hawaii in 2018 after dreaming about it for years - I have been fortunate enough to travel my entire life, a privilege that I don't intend to take for granted.

feeds.title: Girl Loves Gloss » Lifestyle
feeds.description: Delving into matters of the heart, tough life decisions, coping with anxiety and stress and how you can be a better you. Girl Loves Gloss is bringing you makeup reviews, the newest product launches and handy tips and tricks about all things in the beauty world.

feeds.title: The Urban Umbrella
feeds.description: The Urban Umbrella is a Canadian beauty, lifestyle, and style blog. This online destination focuses on helping readers discover their unique sense of style, celebrate their individual beauty, & embrace the joys of simple cooking. I'm Bree, the blogger behind The Urban Umbrella. I live in Vancouver, BC with my husband, Jeremy, and our two cats - Ollie & Holly. Stop by my Instagram and hit follow to see where we're at now!

feeds.title: Raincouver Beauty » Lifestyle
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Angela and welcome to Raincouver Beauty! I test and share swatches and reviews of the latest beauty products. I also love to travel the world especially if I can sip on a glass of wine!

feeds.title: The Flora Law
feeds.description: This blog is where I'll post about fashion, beauty, travel, and all the things in between. I want to share everything that I find worthwhile with you! A bit about me... I'm a dog person, wine lover, and writer for my Vancouver-based fashion and lifestyle blog, TheFloraLaw! I live in Vancouver, British Columbia where I studied communications and publishing in university, after that I began my career in marketing.

feeds.title: Izzabelle Blog » Lifestyle
feeds.description: A little space to share my thoughts and experiences on travel, lifestyle, relationships and Christian living. I created izzabelle.co in 2017 when I moved to Vancouver, Canada from Singapore. I currently work as a freelance journalist and social media strategist while also studying theology-and I'm loving every minute of it! My articles on fashion, beauty, lifestyle, and travel have been featured in various editorial publications in Singapore and Canada

feeds.title: Glamourspirit Blog
feeds.description: Explore articles on Lifestyle, Fashion, Beauty, Travels, Motherhood. Ever since she laid her first clicks on European blogs ten years ago, Yvonna was mesmerized by the effortless chic street style of the European bloggers and understood what they were doing- inspiring through fashion and she hopes to do the same!

feeds.title: Tammy Lynn McNabb Blog
feeds.description: Read Tammy-Lynn McNabb's Blog. She talks about things that interest her like food, travel, health tips, wellness ideas, recipes and more! Follow her blog to improve your life and become a better, more health-conscience you! Tammy-Lynn is a TV producer, Radio Host, Registered Holistic Nutritionist and published book author.

feeds.title: VITA Daily
feeds.description: Vitadaily.ca marks the ongoing evolution of Vitamindaily.com: a freshened-daily website and group of nine savvy, online e-newsletters in major Canadian cities that target educated, fun-loving women who are starved for time and hungry for information. We dispense short, good-for-you 'style supplements' on topics like fashion, health, beauty, décor, arts, culture, dining and travel that are timely, relevant and the first thing you read in the morning.

feeds.title: To Vogue or Bust
feeds.description: To Vogue or Bust's mission is to create a space that empowers and educates the modern woman to live her most adventurous, meaningful, and beautiful life. Whether it's venturing off on your first solo trip, mastering a key seasonal trend, or transitioning into motherhood for the first time, its message is always the same - live your best life in the most beautiful way possible. Get into their blog and learn more about updates, articles, travel, lifestyle, and more.

feeds.title: LegalLee Blonde » Lifestyle
feeds.description: LegalLee Blonde is a Vancouver-based fashion and lifestyle blog dedicated to providing young working women with outfit ideas, style tips, and shopping guides. My name is Lee and I'm a lawyer in Vancouver, Canada. My first career goal was to be a ninja turtle. The pink one. With a glittered shell. Luckily for me, my 7th grade teacher told me I should become a lawyer.

feeds.title: Ava To Zoe
feeds.description: Ava to Zoe is a Vancouver Based Lifestyle Blog that is play on Janette's two young daughters' names. Ava To Zoe is a safe place to fall & know you're not alone! You can expect fun recipes, honest & real reviews, travel and everything in between!
